title: Canada map: the camping pin wins
kaylee: Tapping the camping pin on the Canada map opens camping, even when Sparkle's balloon floats right behind it.

pictures.title: iPhone
pictures.caption: The balloon used to hide behind the camping pin and catch your taps. Now a tap on any heart pin goes to the pin.

pictures.caption: The balloon floats a little further north, clear of the camping pin.
